questions.question: Voting rights in the IMF are distributed on the basis of ___________.

options.text: proportion to the share of the income of the country in the world income
proportion of contributions given by each country
proportion to quota allotted to countries from time to the time

questions.solution:
• The **International Monetary Fund (IMF) **is an international organization consisting of 189 countries working to foster global monetary cooperation, secure financial stability, facilitate international trade, promote high employment and sustainable economic growth and also to reduce poverty around the world.
 
• Voting power in the IMF is purely based on a **quota system.**
 
• So, voting rights in the IMF are distributed on the basis of proportion to quota allotted to countries from time to time.

questions.question: The purpose of land reforms was to achieve __________.

options.text: increase the purchasing power of the rural population
ensure distributive justice with economic growth

questions.solution:
__
 
• **Land reform **involves the changing of laws, regulations or customs regarding the land ownership.
 
• The main purpose of land reforms in India are:
 
 
• Rational use of Resources
 
• Raising Production level
 
• Removal of Exploitation
 
• Social Welfare
 
• Planned Development
 
• Raising the Standard of living
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Land reforms are the reforms that involve change of laws, regulations or customs with respect to the ownership of the land.
 
• According to the great economist Prof. According to Gunnar Myrdal, “the land reforms are the planning and institutional restructuring of the relations between the man and the land".
 
• At the time of independence, in most of the agricultural sector of the country, the role of mediators existed between the tenant and the owner of the land.
 
• There was no guarantee of this landholding and certainty in rent. Therefore, after independence, the cultivator was given the real rights of the land.
 
• To do this, the process of land reform was adopted, which was considered a progressive process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Following were the objectives of the Land Reforms:

 
• To remove the existing institutional anomalies in the agriculture sector and to rationalize and modernize the sector by steps such as land ownership, land rights, paying attention to tenant safety ,etc.
 
• To eliminate economic inequality and to achieve social equality.
 
• To obtain and establish a public welfare state.
 
• Eradicating poverty and imparting common beliefs among the people.
 
• To end the old land relations and establish a new system in which the cultivators of the land are its actual owner.
 
• Ending social injustice, strengthening the position of tenants and, granting equal rights for all sections of the rural population

questions.question: The Indian Council of 1892 Act was based on which plan?
questions.solution:
• The Indian Councils Act 1892 was an Act of Parliament of the United Kingdom that authorized an **increase in the size of the various legislative councils** in British India.
 
• **Viceroy Lord Dufferin** setup a committee and it had a responsibility to draw a plan for the enlargement of provincial councils and enhancement of their status.
 
• So, The Indian Council of 1892 Act was based on Dufferin Plain.

questions.question: Blood is a connective tissue embedded in which type of intercellular matrix?
questions.solution:
• **Blood **is called a liquid connective tissue because it connects various body tissues and organs together by oxygen, hormones and various nutrients.
 
• The intercellular fluid bathes and surrounds the cells of the body, and provides a means of delivering materials to the cells, intercellular communication, and removal of metabolic waste.
 
• Blood is a connective tissue embedded in a fluid type of intercellular matrix.

questions.question: Slow-growing large colored patches on the bark of trees are the examples of symbiotic life forms called ________.
questions.solution:
• A **Lichen** is a composite organism that arises from **algae or cyanobacteria** living among filaments in a symbiotic relationship.
 
• **Symbiosis** is any type of a close and long-term biological interaction between two different biological organisms.
 
• Slow-growing large colored patches on the bark of trees are the examples of symbiotic life forms called **lichen.**

questions.question: What is the heat generated (in J) in a heating element of resistance 800 Ω when a current of 0.2 A passes through it for 40 seconds?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Resistance, R = 800 Ω

Current, I = 0.2 A

Time, t = 40 seconds

To find:

Heat

Formula:

The Heat in joules is given by **H = I²Rt**

**Calculation:**

H = I²Rt

H = (0.2)²(800)(40)

**H = 1280 (J)**
